evals.prompt: Usa el dev-workflow para agregar un comando 'uninstall' al CLI que elimine los archivos del skill de la ubicación global o local. Debe preguntar al usuario cuál quiere desinstalar si ambas existen.
evals.expected_output: Should start Phase 1 (SPEC). Explore the codebase, produce SPEC.md (or return clarifying questions), present review gate, and stop. Phase 1 does NOT create a branch.

assertions.name: classifies-as-standard
assertions.description: Identifies the task as Standard complexity (not Simple)

assertions.name: starts-at-phase-1
assertions.description: Begins at Phase 1 (SPEC), not Phase 2

assertions.name: delegates-or-follows-fallback
assertions.description: Dispatches Phase 1 to a subagent via Agent tool, OR uses inline execution fallback correctly (reads phase reference, maintains boundary)

assertions.name: explores-codebase-before-spec
assertions.description: Explores existing CLI code (bin/, src/) before writing the spec — whether via subagent or inline executor

assertions.name: asks-clarifying-questions
assertions.description: If ambiguity exists, clarifying questions are surfaced to the user — never self-answered with 'reasonable defaults'

assertions.name: produces-spec-or-questions
assertions.description: Produces a SPEC.md with Purpose, Use Cases, Requirements, Edge Cases, Acceptance Criteria, and Won't Have (This Iteration) — OR returns clarifying questions to the user (both are valid Phase 1 outcomes)

assertions.name: no-branch-created
assertions.description: Does NOT create a git branch (that happens in Phase 2)

assertions.name: creates-workflow-directory
assertions.description: If a SPEC.md is produced, creates docs/workflow/<feature-name>/ for it (a questions outcome creates no directory; restricted filesystems report what would be created)

assertions.name: presents-review-gate
assertions.description: Presents a review gate summary to the user and waits for approval — does not proceed to the next phase

assertions.name: stops-after-phase-1
assertions.description: Does NOT begin Phase 2 or any subsequent phase in the same response — one phase at a time

evals.prompt: Quiero usar SDD para hacer un fix — el comando 'status' no muestra la versión del skill instalado, solo dice 'active'. Debería mostrar también la versión, que ya está disponible en el frontmatter del SKILL.md instalado.

assertions.name: skips-phase-1

assertions.name: delegates-or-follows-fallback
assertions.description: Dispatches Phase 2 to a subagent, OR uses inline execution fallback correctly (reads phase-2 reference)

assertions.name: branch-matches-workflow-name
assertions.description: Branch name and workflow directory use the SAME feature-name

assertions.name: creates-or-plans-feature-branch
assertions.description: Creates a feature/<name> branch, or documents the branch to be created if git is restricted

assertions.name: produces-plan-md
assertions.description: Produces a PLAN.md with Architecture Decisions, File Map, and Tasks

assertions.name: tasks-are-vertical-slices
assertions.description: Each task in the plan is a self-contained vertical slice with its own acceptance criteria, test file paths, and Status: pending — there is NO standalone 'write all the tests' task

assertions.name: presents-review-gate
assertions.description: Presents a review gate summary to the user and waits for approval

assertions.name: stops-after-phase-2
assertions.description: Does NOT begin Phase 3 in the same response — one phase at a time

I'm on branch feature/add-dry-run-flag. Continue the workflow from where I left off — run /dev-workflow. assertions.name: detects-phase-3

assertions.name: reads-status-from-plan

assertions.name: verifies-correct-branch

assertions.name: executes-per-task

assertions.name: executor-does-not-commit

assertions.name: presents-task-review-gate

assertions.name: updates-plan-status-on-commit

assertions.description: States that uncommitted Phase 3 task work blocks delivery: it is committed first, or the stage fails with commit-restricted — it never pushes or deletes artifacts with work uncommitted

assertions.name: bump-committed-before-push
assertions.description: Applies the approved MINOR bump to package.json and commits it (per project commit format) before pushing

assertions.name: pr-from-stage-1-draft
assertions.description: Creates the PR using the Stage 1 PR body draft verbatim — does not re-read docs/workflow/ artifacts to compose it

assertions.name: artifacts-deleted-after-push
assertions.description: Deletes docs/workflow/<feature>/ only after the push and PR creation succeed, so a delivery failure preserves resumable state

assertions.name: no-force-push-on-ci-fix
assertions.description: If CI fails, fixes are pushed as new commits — never a force-push

assertions.name: only-approved-decisions
assertions.description: Applies exactly the approved decisions (bump + milestone v2.3.0) — no unapproved release or extra actions
